about.heading: Hello, I'm Gaurav.
about.intro: Passionate software developer with 4+ years of experience building Android and web applications. Quick to pick up new technologies and always looking for smart, efficient solutions. Skilled in handling the entire development process, from brainstorming ideas to launching and scaling products.
about.experienceIntro: From growth funnels and AI features at Unacademy, to a multi-module KMM lending app for US credit unions, to Federal Bank's credit card stack — I own features end to end, from architecture to Play Store.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
points: Engineered Google Ads deferred deep linking with AppsFlyer attribution fallback, recovering incorrectly routed paid installs by 54% and ensuring campaign-specific onboarding for new learners.
Architected a cost-efficient AI chatbot with caching layers and conversation history management, streamlining doubt resolution and increasing Play Store ratings from 4.1 to 4.5.
Integrated OTPless SDK with silent network authentication and OTP fallback, reducing signup drop-offs by 30%.
Delivered gamified, Rive-animated daily reward and streak experiences across Airlearn and Unacademy Sprint, driving over 6% improvement in D7 retention for 70K+ daily active users.
Tools: Kotlin, Compose, Java, XML, Fragments, Coroutines, React Native, Jenkins, Firebase, Paging 3, Rive, Lottie, Amplitude, ExoPlayer, CameraX.

experiences.title: Software Engineer, Mobile
points: Led mobile development of Algebrik's cloud-native, AI-enabled loan origination platform for Credit Unions in the US, targeting 100K+ users on Android and iOS.
Built core flows including mobile authentication (OTP), camera-based KYC capture and secure document upload, enabling 95% digital onboarding for loan applicants.

Architected a scalable multi-module Android architecture spanning core, shared and feature modules, modularising 50%+ of the codebase and improving development and testing efficiency by 25% through developer tooling.
Tools: Jetpack Compose, KMM, Ktor, Koin, iOS, MVVM, MVI, CI/CD, Clean Architecture, SOLID Principles.

experiences.title: Software Developer
points: SaaS Marketplace: Spearheaded the development of a subscription marketplace from the ground up, leading to a 40-50% upsurge in Gross Merchandise Value monthly post-launch.
Accounted for approximately 26% of desktop and 43% of mobile screens, developing essential features such as Transaction screen, Login/Signup screen, User Migration and Order Review screen.
FedMobile Android and Card Stack: Led the Credit Card SDK team, creating essential features such as Razorpay Push Provisioning and the NCMC Wallet, which boosted functionality by 9%.
Developed the RuPay Floater Card (UPI-enabled credit cards), Secured Credit Card and revamped UPI Card Controls, resulting in a 4% increase in user transaction volume.
Tools: Core Java, RxJava, LiveData, Kotlin, Coroutines, Flows, Retrofit, OkHttp, Dagger Hilt, JUnit, Mockito, RoomDB, LeakCanary, ProGuard, Flutter, GitHub Actions.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science
